subject: sounds
title: ABC order
about: Which letter comes next, which comes just before, which of three letters is first in ABC order, and the first and last letters of the alphabet. Knowing the alphabet as a sequence is part of NC RF.1.1 (print concepts, built on the Kindergarten letter names) and is what he needs to use the class word wall and a picture dictionary.
tip: Sing the ABC song up to the letter and stop; the next letter pops out by itself.

cards.q: Which letter is first in the alphabet?
cards.note: The alphabet starts with a: a, b, c.

cards.q: Which letter is last in the alphabet?
cards.note: z is the very last letter: x, y, z.

cards.q: Which letter comes right after a?
cards.sayQ: Which letter comes right after A?
cards.note: a, b. b comes right after a.

cards.q: What comes next: a, b, c, ...?
cards.sayQ: A, B, C. What comes next?
cards.note: a, b, c, d. Sing it and stop after c.

cards.q: Which letter comes right after h?
cards.sayQ: Which letter comes right after H?
cards.note: g, h, i. i comes right after h.

cards.q: What comes next: l, m, n, ...?
cards.sayQ: L, M, N. What comes next?
cards.note: l, m, n, o. Sing it and stop after n.

cards.q: Which letter comes right after s?
cards.sayQ: Which letter comes right after S?
cards.note: r, s, t. t comes right after s.

cards.q: What comes next: j, k, l, ...?
cards.sayQ: J, K, L. What comes next?
cards.note: j, k, l, m. Sing it and stop after l.

cards.q: What comes next: w, x, y, ...?
cards.sayQ: W, X, Y. What comes next?
cards.note: w, x, y, z. The song ends with z.

cards.q: Which letter comes right before f?
cards.sayQ: Which letter comes right before F?
cards.note: e, f. e comes right before f.

cards.q: What letter is just before p?
cards.sayQ: What letter is just before P?
cards.note: o, p. o comes right before p.

cards.q: Which letter comes right before z?
cards.sayQ: Which letter comes right before Z?
cards.note: y, z. y comes right before z.

cards.q: Which letter is just before d?
cards.sayQ: Which letter is just before D?
cards.note: c, d. c comes right before d.

cards.q: Which of these letters comes first in ABC order?
cards.sayQ: Which of these letters comes first in ABC order? C, K or R?
cards.note: c comes early in the alphabet, k is in the middle, r is near the end.

cards.q: Of these three, which comes first in ABC order?
cards.sayQ: Of these three, which comes first in ABC order? M, S or W?
cards.note: m comes before s, and s comes before w.

cards.q: Which letter would you sing first in the ABC song?
cards.sayQ: Which letter would you sing first in the ABC song? E, T or Y?
cards.note: e comes early in the song, t and y come near the end.

cards.q: Which of these letters comes last in ABC order?
cards.sayQ: Which of these letters comes last in ABC order? B, G or P?
cards.note: b comes first, then g, then p.

cards.q: How many letters are in the alphabet?
cards.note: There are 26 letters, from a to z.
